cues.zh: 嘿，你！你几年前可能听说过比特币的一些消息。
cues.en: Hey!, you!, you may have seen something about Bitcoin a few years back.

cues.zh: 听起来挺革命性的。这东西要取代银行。
cues.en: It sounded revolutionary. This was going to replace the banks.

cues.zh: 它是无需许可的去中心化点对点电子现金。
cues.en: It was permissionless decentralized peer-to-peer electronic cash.

cues.zh: 没人能把它从你手里拿走。你可以花不到一美分发任意金额，速度还快。
cues.en: No one can take it from you. You can send any amount for less than a penny fast.

cues.zh: 但该死，当时价格是100美元，而且它大概率会失败，所以
cues.en: But damn, the price was $100 and it would probably fail anyways so

cues.zh: 你还是稳妥点，看看会发生什么吧。
cues.en: you better play safe and see what happens.

cues.zh: 然后你最近在新闻上看到价格，
cues.en: Then you saw the price recently on the news,

cues.zh: 15000美元，你的心一下子沉了下去，因为你意识到自己本可以多有钱，
cues.en: $15,000 and immediately your stomach drop, because you realized that how rich you could have been,

cues.zh: 但你搞砸了。
cues.en: but you blew it.

cues.zh: 但你意识到，它还在快速上涨，如果你现在投资，
cues.en: But you realize, that is still going up fast and if you invest now,

cues.zh: 你大概还算是早期入场。
cues.en: you're probably still in the ground floor.

cues.zh: 等你终于拿到比特币，等了五个小时才确认，你发现少了一些。
cues.en: When you finally get your Bitcoin, after waiting five hours for it to confirm, you realize that some is missing.

cues.zh: 结果你那区区三十美元的投资，
cues.en: Turns out that your small investment of thirty dollars,

cues.zh: 其中十五美元是转账手续费，用来把它放进你的钱包
cues.en: fifteen dollars went towards the transfer fee to put it in your wallet

cues.zh: 这就是那个要改变世界的东西？
cues.en: This is what was going to change the world?

cues.zh: 我来告诉你，你不在的时候发生了什么。
cues.en: Let me fill you in on what happened, while you were gone.

cues.zh: 交易费之所以出现，是因为区块大小。
cues.en: Transaction fees have arisen because of the block size.

cues.zh: 目前区块大小是 1 兆字节，每秒只能容纳少数几笔交易。
cues.en: The block size is 1 megabyte currently. It only allows for a few transactions per second to take place.

cues.zh: 实际发生的交易远多于此，所以出价最高的人能优先处理。
cues.en: Many more happen than this, so the people who pay the highest fee get to go first in line.

cues.zh: 2017 年 12 月 12 日，也就是我录制这期视频的时候，
cues.en: On december 12, 2017 at the time i'm recording this video,

cues.zh: 今天的平均交易手续费
cues.en: the average transaction fee today

cues.zh: 是二十四美元四十美分
cues.en: was twenty four dollars and forty cents

cues.zh: 随着时间推移和采用范围扩大，这个问题只会越来越严重
cues.en: This problem only gets worse with time and his adoption spreads

cues.zh: 开发团队没有再次提高区块大小
cues.en: Instead of raising the block size again

cues.zh: 而是决定采用第二层方案，叫做闪电网络（Lightning Network）。
cues.en: The development team has decided to go for a second layer called the Lightning Network.

cues.zh: 它承诺交易即时到账、手续费极低……这就是它的基本工作原理：
cues.en: It promises instant transactions, super low fees... and this is the basics of how it works:

cues.zh: 假设我和你经常交易，于是我们开通一个容量为两个比特币的通道。
cues.en: Let's say me and you transact regularly so we open a channel for two Bitcoins.

cues.zh: 我和你各向一个多重签名地址存入一个比特币
cues.en: I send a Bitcoin and you send a Bitcoin to a multi signature address

cues.zh: 这些比特币会暂时锁在那里。
cues.en: where it's temporarily locked away.

cues.zh: 现在，只要我们双方都为每笔交易签名，就可以免费来回交易这两个比特币。
cues.en: Now we are free to trade two Bitcoins back and forth with no fees, as long as we both sign each transaction.

cues.zh: 这是因为比特币本身从未转移。我们实际上是在链下交易这枚比特币的使用权，类似一张欠条。
cues.en: This is because the actual Bitcoin was never moved. We're essentially trading for the rights of the coin, offchain, similar to an IOU.

cues.zh: 关闭通道时，交易会在区块链上结算。
cues.en: When we close our channel it settles on the Blockchain.

cues.zh: 我们兑现欠条，各自拿回应得的真实比特币。
cues.en: Our IOUs are redeemed and we'll get our share of the real Bitcoin.

cues.zh: 只有开通或关闭通道进行结算时，才会产生较高的交易手续费。
cues.en: The only time the high transaction fee occurs, is when you open or close a channel to settle up.

cues.zh: 你想和一个没有直接通道的人交易。
cues.en: You want to transact with somebody you don't have a direct channel open with.

cues.zh: 假设你想和 Bob 交易，付给他 1 个比特币。
cues.en: Let's say you want to transact with Bob, and pay him 1 Bitcoin.

cues.zh: Bob 目前和你没有开通通道。而你也不想再花手续费去开一个新通道。
cues.en: Bob does not currently have an open channel with you. And you don't want to have to pay the fees to open another channel.

cues.zh: 巧的是，我的表弟 Sam 和 Bob 之间有一个开通的通道。
cues.en: It turns out that my first cousin Sam has an open channel with Bob.

cues.zh: 你可以通过我们的通道付款，
cues.en: You could send the payments through our channel

cues.zh: 走我和 Sam 之间的通道，最后再从 Sam 到 Bob，
cues.en: and use the channel I have opened with Sam and finally from Sam to Bob

cues.zh: 只要给我和 Sam 支付极少的交易手续费，作为使用我们通道的费用。
cues.en: paying me and Sam very small transaction fees for using our open channels.

cues.zh: 理想情况下，网络就是这样运作的，
cues.en: This is ideally how, the network would work,

cues.zh: 从一个人跳到另一个人，直到你的交易到达目标收款人。
cues.en: hopping from individual to individual until your transaction meets the intended recipient.

cues.zh: 但可惜 Sam 没我们这么走运，
cues.en: But it turns out that Sam isn't as fortunate as us

cues.zh: 我们的通道里只存了 0.5 个比特币。
cues.en: and our channel only as 0.5 Bitcoins deposited.

cues.zh: 这样行不通。每个通道上必须预先加载足够的资金
cues.en: This won't work. There has to be enough loaded on each channel

cues.zh: 才能使用。网络还得找到另一条路径。
cues.en: along the way for it to be used. And the network must find another route.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，Bob和你都经常在同一家披萨店消费，所以你们都有开放的通道
cues.en: Luckily it turns out that Bob and you both eat at the same pizza shop regularly enough that you both have open channels

cues.zh: 这家披萨店的通道里有充足的比特币，而且比上一个例子少了一跳。
cues.en: The pizza shop has plenty of Bitcoin in its channel and is one less hop than the last example.

cues.zh: Bob收到付款，你少付了手续费，披萨店因提供有用服务而获得奖励
cues.en: Bob gets paid, less fees for you, and the pizza shop gets a reward for providing a useful service

cues.zh: 所有人都赢
cues.en: Everyone wins

cues.zh: 至少看起来是这样
cues.en: Or so it would seem

cues.zh: 这个系统的一个问题是，需要提前为每个开放通道预加载资金，
cues.en: A problem with the system is the requirement to preload every open channel you have ahead of time,

cues.zh: 金额还得按你预估的、与该通道相关的消费上限来定。
cues.en: with what you assume will be the upper limit of your spending habits with that channel.

cues.zh: 更方便的做法是，只开一个通道，存入大量比特币，连接到一个连接良好的节点，
cues.en: It's more convenient to have one open channel, and a large amount of Bitcoin, to a well connected party,

cues.zh: 这个节点的资金始终比你多，这样你总能通过它来路由
cues.en: that consistently has more money than you so you can, always route through

cues.zh: 这就是为什么枢纽节点会自然出现。
cues.en: This is why hubs will naturally occur.

cues.zh: 闪电枢纽是一个节点，拥有足够多已开启的通道和充足可用流动性。
cues.en: A Lightning hub is a node with enough channels open and enough liquidity available.

cues.zh: 通过连接它们，你限制了自己需要亲自开启的通道数量，
cues.en: By connecting them, you limit the amount of channels you need to personally open,

cues.zh: 无需再担心它们的余额，
cues.en: never have to worry about their balance,

cues.zh: 并减少交易所需的跳数和费用。
cues.en: and reduce the amount of hops and fees required to make transactions.

cues.zh: 与矿工不同——矿工实际上并不转移价值，
cues.en: Unlike miners, who don't actually transfer value,

cues.zh: 这些枢纽很可能被归类为第三方结算机构。
cues.en: these hubs will likely be classified as third-party settlement organizations.

cues.zh: 从而受到严格金融监管法律的约束，例如KYC和AML。
cues.en: Being subject to heavy financial regulation laws, such as KYC and AML.

cues.zh: 另外，与链上交易不同，这个系统中存在被盗的风险。
cues.en: Also unlike on chain transactions there is a chance of theft in the system.

cues.zh: 如果另一方试图广播某个通道的旧状态，
cues.en: If another party attempts to broadcast a channel in an old state,

cues.zh: 而你没能及时抓住他们，他们就能试图偷走你的比特币。
cues.en: they can try to steal your Bitcoin if you can't catch them in time.

cues.zh: 为此，你要么需要运行一个完整的比特币节点，
cues.en: For this you will either need to run a full Bitcoin node,

cues.zh: 始终保持在线，自己监控交易，
cues.en: that'll always be online to monitor the transactions yourself,

cues.zh: 要么雇一个第三方服务替你完成这件事。
cues.en: or hire a third-party service to do this on your behalf.

cues.zh: 因此，闪电网络枢纽将需要遵守金融监管和报告法律
cues.en: So, the Lightning hubs will require to be set up financial regulation and reporting laws

cues.zh: 需要大量流动性来维持多个资金充足的开放通道。
cues.en: Require massive amounts of liquidity to keep multiple well-funded open channels.

cues.zh: 提供欺诈检测部门，持续监控区块链并防止盗窃。
cues.en: Offer fraud departments to watch the blockchain constantly and prevent theft.

cues.zh: 同时对你通过它们路由的每笔交易收取小额费用。
cues.en: All while taking small fees for every transaction you route through them.

cues.zh: 这个系统听起来熟悉吗？
cues.en: Does this system sound familiar?

cues.zh: 只需把“开放通道”这个词换成“支票账户”
cues.en: Just replace the term "open channel" with "checking account"

cues.zh: 这些闪电网络枢纽，将由那些比特币本要挑战的金融机构来运营。
cues.en: These Lightning Network hubs, will be ran by the same financial institutions the Bitcoin was made to challenge.

cues.zh: 银行并没有在对抗比特币，因为比特币将成为新的银行系统。
cues.en: The banks aren't fighting Bitcoin, because Bitcoin will be the new banking system.

cues.zh: 比特币不需要中间人，没有欺诈需要检测，不需要给予许可，
cues.en: Bitcoin needed no middleman, there was no fraud to detect, no permission to give,

cues.zh: 没有交易需要撤销，没有费用需要收取。
cues.en: no transaction to reverse, no fees to collect.

cues.zh: 所以必须把它弄坏，才需要它们，而最糟的是你别无选择。
cues.en: So it had to be broken to need them, and the worst part is you won't have a choice.

cues.zh: 要么放弃自由，使用闪电网络，
cues.en: Either give up your freedom and use the Lightning Network,

cues.zh: 要么承受两位甚至三位数、不断上涨的手续费，
cues.en: or be subject to double or even triple digit ever-increasing fees,

cues.zh: 你在区块链上的每一步操作都要付。
cues.en: for every move you make on the Blockchain.

cues.zh: 事实是，限制比特币的 1MB 区块上限，是开发者故意保留的。
cues.en: The truth is, the 1 megabyte blocks restricting Bitcoin, are purposely kept there by the developers.

cues.zh: 高得离谱的手续费和漫长等待催生了对解决方案的需求，
cues.en: The absurdly high fees and long waits created demand for a solution

cues.zh: 而他们给我们的解决方案就是银行业。
cues.en: and the solution they give us is the banking industry.

cues.zh: 区块大小限制，是比特币创造者中本聪设置的临时保护措施。
cues.en: The block size restriction, was placed as a temporary safeguard by Bitcoin's creator Satoshi Nakamoto.

cues.zh: 一旦区块接近填满，就应该再次提高上限。
cues.en: As soon as the blocks were close to being full it was to be raised again.

cues.zh: 中本聪在 2010 年神秘地离开了这个项目，
cues.en: Satoshi mysteriously left the project in 2010,

cues.zh: 但在他离开之前，留下了如何提高区块大小的指示，
cues.en: but before he did he left instructions on how to raise the block size,

cues.zh: 并把项目交给 Gavin Andreson 负责。
cues.en: and left Gavin Andreson in charge of the project.

cues.zh: 中本聪离开后，机构资金开始涌入并掌控局面，
cues.en: Once Satoshi left institutional money started to make its way in and take control,

cues.zh: 一家叫 Blockstream 的公司冒了出来。
cues.en: and a company Blockstream emerged.

cues.zh: 久而久之，大部分开发团队成员都成了这家公司的人，或被它雇用，
cues.en: Over time it happened that a large portion of the development team was part of or hired by this company,

cues.zh: 等到下一次区块扩容的时候，
cues.en: and when it came time for another block size increase,

cues.zh: 有一部分开发者觉得这不是个好主意。
cues.en: there was a portion of the developers that thought this was a bad idea.

cues.zh: 而这恰好就是给 Blockstream 干活的那拨开发者。
cues.en: This just so happened to be the same group of developers that work for Blockstream.

cues.zh: Blockstream 是如何接管的故事又长又离奇，我得另做一期视频讲，
cues.en: The story of how Blockstream took over is a long and strange one, and I'll have to cover it in another video,

cues.zh: 但靠着大规模审查、有组织的攻击和操控，
cues.en: but with massive amounts of censorship, organized attacks and manipulation,

cues.zh: Blockstream 成功掌控了比特币的核心开发
cues.en: Blockstream managed to take primary control over the development of Bitcoin

cues.zh: 并逼走了所有反对他们选择的开发者，
cues.en: and force out any of the developers who opposed their choices,

cues.zh: 而对意见一致的人则敞开怀抱。
cues.en: and gave open arms to the ones whose opinions are aligned.

cues.zh: 从那以后，手续费呈指数级上涨，
cues.en: Ever since then, the fees have exponentially risen,

cues.zh: 确认时间从几分钟变成几小时，甚至几天。
cues.en: the confirmation times have have grown from minutes to hours, to days.

cues.zh: 商家也在快速放弃支持。
cues.en: And the merchants are dropping support at a rapid rate.

cues.zh: 区块大小早就该提高了。
cues.en: The block size should have been raised long ago.

cues.zh: 本来可以提高，多年都不会有中心化风险，
cues.en: It could be raised for years without any risk of centralization,

cues.zh: 给我们时间去寻找其他解决方案。
cues.en: giving us time to find other solutions.

cues.zh: 但这不会发生，
cues.en: But it won't happen,

cues.zh: 因为 Blockstream 表示他们计划盈利，
cues.en: because Blockstream states that they plan to turn a profit

cues.zh: 方式是把侧链卖给企业，
cues.en: by selling side chains to businesses,

cues.zh: 让它们接受定制的比特币后链，
cues.en: allowing them to accept custom Bitcoin backchains

cues.zh: 这些后链不受比特币高手续费的困扰，
cues.en: that aren't subject to Bitcoin's high fees,

cues.zh: 每笔交易收取少量费用，
cues.en: taking small fees for every transaction,

cues.zh: 向企业收取固定月费，并出售运行所需的定制硬件。
cues.en: fixed monthly fees from the businesses and selling the custom hardware needed to run them.

cues.zh: 如果比特币运行不正常，这个模式要赚钱得多。
cues.en: This model is far more profitable if Bitcoin doesn't work properly.

cues.zh: 如果手续费很低，没人想用他们的侧链，
cues.en: If the fees are low and no one wants their sidechains,

cues.zh: 那么，他们怎么把7400万美元还给那些投资的企业和大银行家？，
cues.en: then, how will they pay the 74 million dollars back to the corporations and big bankers who have invested?,

cues.zh: 也就是那些从闪电网络枢纽中获益的人。
cues.en: the ones who benefit from the Lightning hubs.

cues.zh: 这项旨在赋予自由、稳定与力量的惊人技术，
cues.en: This amazing technology designed to give freedom,

cues.zh: 让全世界的人们获得自由、稳定与力量
cues.en: stability and power to the people around the world

cues.zh: 却为了权力、控制和利润而被撕碎、摧毁。
cues.en: has been ripped apart and destroyed for power, control, and profit.

cues.zh: 但没关系，因为我们要去月球了……
cues.en: But it's okay, because we're going to the moon...
